prompt: Copilot left review comments on the Crash Course parallelization page in my docs PR. Go through the comments and tell me which ones to take, what to change, and draft a reply for each. Don't edit anything yet.
assertions: Gives an explicit decision (apply, redirect, decline, ask, or equivalent) for every one of the 10 comments

Accepts C1 (missing empty_table import), C2 (prose says 'both return 6' but the table has no 6), and C3 (with_serial alone is insufficient when several columns share state); the C3 fix points readers to barriers or the concept guide
Does not accept C4 as written: declines it or asks, citing that Crash Course page titles are title case by established convention (or an earlier reviewer decision)

For C9, proposes a corrected takeaway at tutorial resolution (e.g. 'treats formulas as safe to run in parallel') rather than enumerating the conditions or naming properties

For C10, verifies the claim against source (e.g. the SelectColumn.isParallelizable javadoc: the engine may evaluate a non-parallelizable column out of order) and keeps the clause or asks, rather than deleting it or adding a hedge
Drafts a reply for every comment, and every reply for a comment that isn't applied gives a reason
note: Baseline (old_skill) = the full skill set at PR commit 364c522207, which has no review-comment skill; with_skill = the set with deephaven-docs-address-review-comments and the related edits. Both arms choose which skill(s) to use from their directory.
